sloka: इत्येवमूचुर्बहवो विशिष्टा रक्षोगणास्तत्र समेत्य सर्वे ।सप्राणिसङ्घां सगृहां सवृक्षां दग्धां पुरीं तां सहसा समीक्ष्य ।। 5.54.39 ।।।।
transliteration: ityevamūcurbahavo viśiṣṭā rakṣogaṇāstatra sametya sarve ।saprāṇisaṅghāṁ sagṛhāṁ savṛkṣāṁ dagdhāṁ purīṁ tāṁ sahasā samīkṣya ।। 5.54.39 ।।।।

translations.english: Lanka with its chariots horses, elephants, flocks of birds, animals and trees burnt all of a sudden, the ogres cried loudly and piteously.
